title: The Contradictions of Battery Operated Vehicles  | Graham Conway | TEDxSanAntonio
summary: A TEDx talk arguing that battery electric vehicles are not as environmentally friendly as commonly believed and that the rush to adopt them is misguided. TED flagged it as containing claims that lack scientific support.
why: Mentioned only occasionally as a contrarian argument for hybrids over EVs, with no real endorsement.
